const o: any = { a: {} };
const tries: (() => unknown)[] = [
  () => o.foo(),
  () => o.a.b(),
  () => o['x-y'](),
  () => (o as any)(),
  () => o.a.b.c(),
  () => new o.a(),
  () => new (o as any)(),
  () => (5 as any)(),
];
for (const t of tries) { try { t(); } catch (e: any) { console.log(e.constructor.name, e.message); } }
